//: The codebase is plain JavaScript, not TypeScript. This config exists so
`npm run typecheck` can use the TypeScript compiler as a static analyser:
it reads the JSDoc annotations across src/ and catches misspelled imports,
bad property access and wrong call signatures that ESLint cannot see.
`checkJs` is off globally on purpose: JSX components infer every destructured
prop as required, so a blanket check buries real findings under thousands of
false positives. Instead, modules opt in one at a time with a `// @ts-check`
